pill.desc: clear, colorless to slightly yellow-brown solution in a single-dose vial

clues.kinetics: It binds neither plasma proteins nor erythrocytes, and about 96% of the dose leaves the body in urine, mostly unchanged.
clues.substance: The sodium salt of a modified gamma cyclodextrin, with a molecular weight of 2178.01. It is a sterile aqueous solution.
clues.product: Approved under an NDA as single-dose vials of 200 mg/2 mL and 500 mg/5 mL, each at 100 mg/mL, given as one bolus injection.
clues.safety: No boxed warning; contraindicated in known hypersensitivity to the drug or its components. Pain and vomiting are among the most frequent adverse reactions in pediatric patients.
clues.indication: Reversal of neuromuscular blockade induced by rocuronium or vecuronium in adult and pediatric patients undergoing surgery.
clues.mechanism: Forms a complex with rocuronium and vecuronium, reducing the amount of blocker free to bind nicotinic receptors at the neuromuscular junction.

tell: A modified gamma cyclodextrin that binds the blocker itself rather than the receptor, and leaves the body unchanged in urine.

evidence.pk.tmaxH: Administer as a single bolus injection
evidence.pk.halfLifeH: the elimination half-life (t 1/2 ) of sugammadex is about 2 hours
